questions.title: Am I doing this right? Status reports
questions.timestamp_semantics: Evidence log written after separately opening and reading original post body through web.run; not a claimed server fetch timestamp.
questions.inspection: Original body, lines 21-31; original-author clarification, lines 70-75. Distinct original post, not search snippet or vendor tutorial.
questions.observed_problem: A project coordinator loses project context after a key colleague leaves. They collect weekly updates in Monday.com and ask how to report them so details stop getting lost; they want executive summaries and meetings focused on decisions and stuck points.
questions.editorial_implication: Give an explicit weekly source-collection step, named input labels and a checked report with blockers/decisions; make retrieval ownership and unsupported completion visible.
limitations: Historical question freshly inspected; exact creation time not independently retrieved.
US geography unknown; English-language post only.
The user's desired board automation and meeting reduction are outside this manual prompt/template scope; no Monday connector or time-saving outcome promised.
